Adaptive Cruise Control and Collision Warning are part of the truck's active safety and driver-assist equipment, and they fit naturally with the Denali Ultimate grade's more comprehensive approach to standard comfort and control. The result is a truck that retains the underlying hardware expected of a Sierra 3500HD while adding a more specialized suspension and wheel package to the chassis.

The custom treatment across the grille, bedside, step inserts, window moldings, tailgate appliqué, and emblems keeps the truck visually consistent, while the gloss black top and smoked rear lamps continue that theme at the roofline and rear. Downpour Metallic paint gives the body a deeper factory color base, and the modified elements are carried out in a way that remains readable as part of the truck rather than layered on afterward. This 2025 Ford F-150 Raptor in Black represents serious capability paired with refined comfort for the truck owner who refuses to compromise on either front.

- Twin Panel Moonroof
- Equipment Group 802A Raptor 37 with Dual Valve Shocks
- Raptor 37 Unique 17" Cast Aluminum Wheels with 37x12.5R17 All-Terrain Tires
- Tough Bed Spray-In Bedliner
- Modular Front Bumper
- Carbon Fiber Interior Appliques
- 3.5L EcoBoost V6 with 10-Speed Automatic and 4WD
- B&O Unleashed Sound System by Bang & Olufsen with 14 Speakers
- RECARO Alcantara Suede Front Seats with Heating and Ventilation
- SYNC 4 with Enhanced Voice Recognition and Connected Navigation
- Heads-Up Display
- Electronic Locking Differential with 4.10 Axle Ratio
- Heated Steering Wheel
- Backup Camera with Remote Keyless Entry
- FordPass Connect 5G with Internet Access

The heart of this truck is its 3.5L EcoBoost V6 engine paired with a 10-Speed Automatic transmission and 4WD, delivering the performance and control you expect from the Raptor nameplate. City driving returns 15 MPG while highway driving achieves 18 MPG, reflecting real-world efficiency for a truck of this caliber. With 23,964 miles, this vehicle has been well-maintained and is ready for years of dependable service.

Inside, the cabin reflects Raptor's premium positioning. RECARO Alcantara Suede front seats with heating and ventilation provide comfort on long drives and demanding terrain. The heated steering wheel and dual-zone automatic climate control ensure comfort in any weather, while the split-folding rear seat maximizes versatility. Memory functions for seats, pedals, and steering wheel allow you to customize the driving experience to your specifications. Leather trimming throughout reinforces the quality feel, and carbon fiber interior appliques add visual interest.

Technology integration is seamless with SYNC 4 featuring Enhanced Voice Recognition, Connected Navigation, and internet access capable through FordPass Connect 5G. The Heads-Up Display keeps critical information visible without distraction, while the B&O Unleashed Sound System with 14 speakers and SiriusXM with 360L delivers premium audio entertainment. Smartphone integration is straightforward, and the system responds intuitively to your commands.

The Raptor's distinctive exterior is defined by its purposeful design and aggressive stance. The Modular Front Bumper provides customization options and enhanced approach capability. Raptor 37 Unique 17" Cast Aluminum Wheels finished in a distinctive style are wrapped in 37x12.5R17 BSW All-Terrain tires that command attention on pavement and perform when conditions demand more. Bead lock capable wheels accommodate serious off-road preparation. The Twin Panel Moonroof opens up the cabin with natural light and fresh air.

Safety systems include dual front and side impact airbags, an occupant sensing system, overhead airbags, and Emergency communication through SYNC 4 911 Assist. Lane Departure Warning System, Electronic Stability Control, and Traction Control work together to maintain control in varying conditions. The 4-Wheel Disc Brakes with ABS provide confident stopping power. Auto High-beam Headlights, fog lights, and rain-sensing wipers adjust to conditions automatically.

The Tough Bed Spray-In Bedliner protects your payload investment while maintaining the clean lines of the truck bed. The Electronic Locking Differential with 4.10 Axle Ratio provides traction when you need it most, engaging power to all four wheels in demanding situations.

This 2025 Ford F-150 Raptor delivers the complete package—a truck built for both the driveway and the trail. We invite you to schedule a visit to see it in person and experience how Raptor engineering and design come together in this unique vehicle.

The body is finished in a way that suits the taller stance, and the crew cab format provides the full-size cabin space associated with this model. The 2026 GMC Sierra 2500HD AT4 in Beige represents a serious work truck built for demanding tasks and genuine capability. This model combines professional-grade engineering with premium comfort features, making it equally suited for job sites and weekend adventures.

- Duramax 6.6L V8 Turbodiesel engine delivering 470 hp and 975 lb-ft of torque
- 10-Speed Automatic transmission with 2-Speed Active Transfer Case
- AT4 Premium Plus Package including power sunroof and technology upgrades
- Power-Retractable Black Assist Steps with LED lighting
- Bose Premium 7-Speaker Sound System with SiriusXM 360L
- BF Goodrich Off-Road T/A KO3 tires on 20" High Gloss Black aluminum wheels
- HD Surround Vision with multiple camera systems and trailer provisions
- Premium GMC Infotainment System with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Heated and ventilated leather front seats with 10-way power adjustment
- Heated steering wheel and power sunroof
- Engine Block Heater and 220-Amp Alternator for reliability
- Automatic Emergency Braking and comprehensive driver assistance systems
- Wireless device charging and connectivity
- Spray-on Pickup Bedliner with GMC Logo

The Sierra 2500HD AT4 delivers commanding presence on the road. The Duramax diesel engine produces impressive torque for towing and hauling, while the truck's off-road suspension and high-clearance step ensure capability in challenging terrain. The 4WD system provides confidence in varied driving conditions, and the multiple camera views make maneuvering and hitching trailers straightforward.

Inside, this truck prioritizes driver comfort and technology. The premium leather seating surfaces are heated and ventilated, adjustable via power controls, while the Bose sound system transforms every drive into a refined audio experience. The 15-inch head-up display keeps critical information visible without distraction, and wireless charging accommodates your devices seamlessly. Climate controls include dual-zone automatic temperature adjustment and heated rear seats for passenger comfort year-round.

Safety and control features reflect modern truck standards. The truck includes automatic emergency braking, lane departure warning, rear cross traffic alert, and trailer side blind zone alert. Ultrasonic parking sensors assist at low speeds, while the hill descent control and exhaust brake provide additional confidence in steep terrain. The security system and remote keyless entry come equipped as standard protection.

The AT4 trim elevates this Sierra with distinctive styling and purposeful upgrades. The gloss black header grille and LED cargo lighting create a commanding appearance, while the spray-on bedliner protects the truck bed from wear. Front fog lights enhance visibility, and the winter grille cover reflects thoughtful design for seasonal variations.

This 2026 Sierra 2500HD AT4 has been carefully maintained and is ready to serve your needs with diesel efficiency and proven durability. The combination of capability, comfort, and technology makes this truck a practical investment for work and leisure. We invite you to experience the commanding presence and refined performance this truck delivers firsthand at our showroom.

This 2026 Ford F-150 Lariat SuperCrew is finished with a ReadyLIFT 3.5" suspension kit, Arena 20" off-road wheels in gloss black, Nitto Ridge Grappler tires sized 295/60R20, and professionally installed tinted windows backed by a lifetime warranty. It is a 5.5 ft. short bed truck with a 3.31 electronic locking axle ratio, and its equipment list includes the FX4 Off-Road Package and Equipment Group 501A. The truck also carries the front license plate bracket and the 50 State Emissions System, while the added suspension and wheel-and-tire combination gives it a more purposeful stance without changing the fact that it remains a factory-based F-150 Lariat SuperCrew.

Inside, this F-150 Lariat SuperCrew is fitted with leather seats and the Mobile Office Package, bringing a more refined cabin specification to the truck's work-oriented platform. Adaptive Cruise Control, Lane Keep Assist, and Collision Warning are included among the driver-assist features, and the truck is also equipped with a Wi-Fi Hotspot. Premium Audio is part of the build as well, giving the interior a fuller list of comfort and convenience equipment. The cabin materials and options are listed plainly, with the focus on the content present rather than any added embellishment.

- Leather Seats

The truck bed features both a spray-in bedliner and integrated LED lighting for improved visibility and cargo protection.

The Laramie Level 2 Plus Equipment Group brings substantial capability upgrades, including power adjustable pedals with memory, active lane management, remote tailgate release, and adaptive steering. The Uconnect 5 navigation system with 14.4-inch touchscreen allows seamless integration with Apple CarPlay and includes SiriusXM with 360L satellite radio.

Safety and convenience features permeate this truck's design. Auto high beam headlamp control, rain-sensitive windshield wipers, traffic sign recognition, and drowsy driver detection work together to enhance awareness on the road. The rear backup camera with cargo view helps when maneuvering in tight spaces, while the power sunroof adds an open-air element to the cabin.

The Night Edition package introduces sportier styling with black exterior truck badging, gloss black grille billets, body-color grille surround, and a sport performance hood that distinguish this truck from standard Laramie models. This 2022 Ram 3500 Limited Longhorn in striking Delmonico Red represents the capability and refinement you need for serious work and comfortable driving.

- 6.7L Cummins Turbodiesel engine with Diesel Exhaust Brake
- Dual rear wheels with premium 17" aluminum wheels
- 50-gallon fuel tank for extended range
- Uconnect 5 Navigation with 12" touchscreen display
- 17-speaker Harman Kardon premium sound system
- Surround View Camera System with Trailer Reverse Guidance
- Blind Spot and Cross Path Detection
- Power Deployable Running Boards
- Heated and ventilated leather front seats
- Ramcharger Wireless Charging Pad
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity
- SiriusXM satellite radio with 360L
- 4G LTE Wi-Fi Hot Spot
- Power 8-Way adjustable driver and passenger seats

The Cummins 6.7L turbodiesel engine delivers the durability and pulling power that define Ram's reputation in heavy-duty trucks. With a 220-amp alternator, dual 730-amp batteries, and the 50-gallon fuel tank, this truck is engineered for sustained performance under demanding conditions. The 6000-pound front axle and 14,000-pound GVWR provide the foundation for serious towing and hauling capability.

Inside, the Limited Longhorn trim elevates the truck-owning experience with genuine wood accents throughout the cabin, premium filigree leather seats, and a heated steering wheel. The 12" Uconnect 5 Nav touchscreen integrates seamlessly with your smartphone through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, while the 17-speaker Harman Kardon system delivers premium audio quality. The Ramcharger wireless charging pad keeps your devices ready, and the 4G LTE Wi-Fi Hot Spot keeps you connected wherever work takes you.

Safety and convenience features work together to make this truck easier to operate. The Surround View Camera System and CTR Stop Lamp with Cargo View Camera provide visibility when maneuvering, while Trailer Reverse Guidance assists with backing up trailers. Blind Spot and Cross Path Detection alert you to traffic, and the power deployable running boards make entry and exit easier on a truck of this size.

The detailed features continue throughout: power door mirrors with heating, auto-dimming rear-view mirror, fully automatic headlights with delay-off function, and rain-sensing wipers. Memory seating for the driver means your preferred position is restored every time you get in. The truck also includes electronic stability control, traction control, and brake assist to help maintain control in various driving conditions.

This 2022 Ram 3500 Limited Longhorn combines the serious capability required for work with the comfort and technology expected in a premium truck. Contact us today to arrange a viewing and experience this truck firsthand.

This 2024 Ford F-250SD Lariat in White represents a serious work truck built for those who demand capability and comfort. With its Power Stroke 6.7L V8 Turbodiesel engine paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD, this truck is engineered to handle demanding jobs while delivering the refinement expected in a Lariat-trimmed vehicle.

- Chrome Package with 20" chrome PVD aluminum wheels, chrome door handles, and chrome tow hooks
- FX4 Off-Road Package including hill descent control and off-road tuned shock absorbers
- Power Stroke 6.7L V8 Diesel with manual engine exhaust braking and operator commanded regeneration
- SYNC 4 with enhanced voice recognition and connected navigation
- B&O Sound System by Bang & Olufsen with SiriusXM 360L
- Rapid-heat supplemental cab heater with dual 68 AH AGM batteries
- Front leather-trimmed 40/console/40 seats with heating and ventilation
- Electronic locking rear differential with 3.31 axle ratio
- Transfer case and fuel tank skid plates
- 6" angular bright anodized step bars
- Engine block heater and 410 amp dual alternators
- Six upfitter switches for custom accessories
- Auto high-beam headlights with fog lights
- Rear parking camera and emergency communication system

The Lariat trim ensures you're working in style and comfort. The heated and ventilated leather front seats adjust with power controls and memory settings, while the heated steering wheel and automatic temperature control keep you comfortable in any season. The Rapid-Heat supplemental cab heater and engine block heater are designed for demanding winter conditions, and the dual alternators provide ample power for jobsite equipment and accessories.

The FX4 Off-Road Package proves this truck is ready for more than paved routes. Hill descent control, off-road tuned shock absorbers front and rear, and protective skid plates for the transfer case and fuel tank demonstrate Ford's commitment to capability. The electronic locking rear differential works with the 4WD system to maximize traction when you need it most.

Technology meets practicality throughout the cabin. SYNC 4 offers enhanced voice recognition for hands-free control, while the connected navigation system helps you find job sites efficiently. The B&O Sound System elevates every drive, and SiriusXM 360L keeps you connected on long commutes or between locations.

The commanding presence of the Chrome Package speaks for itself—20" chrome PVD wheels, unique chrome mirror caps, chrome door handles, and a chrome exhaust tip give this truck a polished appearance that doesn't sacrifice toughness. The 6" angular step bars combine functionality with style, while the front chrome tow hooks and rear step bumper are ready for action.

Whether tackling challenging terrain or handling everyday professional duties, this F-250SD Lariat combines diesel strength with Lariat refinement. The truck is equipped to support your work while providing the comfort and technology features you'll appreciate during long workdays.

The 9 Alpine speakers with subwoofer add to the audio system, while the controls and display integration keep the cabin equipment organized and easy to use.

The overall build pairs factory equipment with selected aftermarket changes in a way that keeps the truck's use case clear. The lifted suspension, larger off-road tires, and black wheels alter the stance and ground clearance, while the tinted glass and granite paint finish carry through a restrained appearance. Meet the 2025 GMC Sierra 2500HD AT4, a heavy-duty truck engineered to handle demanding work and deliver commanding presence on any road.

- Duramax 6.6L V8 Turbodiesel engine with 470 hp and 975 lb-ft of torque
- 10-Speed Automatic transmission with 4WD capability
- Max Trailering Package with gooseneck/5th wheel prep provisions
- Technology Package featuring rear camera mirror and 15" diagonal head-up display
- Multicolor 15" head-up display for enhanced visibility
- Bose Premium 7-Speaker Sound System with SiriusXM 360L
- Bed View Camera with trailer camera provisions
- HD Surround Vision with ultrasonic front and rear park assist
- Heated and ventilated front seats with heated rear seats
- Spray-on pickup bedliner with GMC logo
- Remote vehicle starter system with push button start
- X31 Off-Road Package with 2-speed active transfer case and hill descent control
- Wireless phone projection and wireless charging
- AT4 Preferred Package including universal home remote and roof marker lamps
- 20" high gloss black aluminum wheels

The Sierra 2500HD AT4 is finished in striking Volcanic Red Tintcoat with body-color wheel arch moldings, commanding attention wherever it goes. The 10-speed automatic transmission works seamlessly with the powerful turbodiesel engine to deliver the capability you need, whether you're towing heavy loads or navigating challenging terrain. The Max Trailering Package provides the frame reinforcement, leaf springs, and 12" rear axle necessary for serious hauling, while the gooseneck/5th wheel prep ensures you're ready when your equipment demands the best.

Inside, this AT4 surrounds you with premium appointments designed for both comfort and functionality. Heated and ventilated front seats with heating for the rear outboard seats ensure comfort across seasons, while the 10-way power-adjustable driver seat with lumbar support accommodates long days behind the wheel. The perforated leather-appointed front seat trim adds refinement to the work-ready interior, and the floor-mounted center console provides convenient storage with charge-only rear USB ports and additional USB connectivity throughout.

Technology integrates seamlessly into your driving experience without distraction. The 15" diagonal head-up display projects critical information directly into your line of sight, the rear camera mirror enhances visibility, and the bed view camera with trailer viewing software simplifies maneuvering with trailers. Wireless phone projection keeps your navigation and communication accessible, while the Bose premium sound system ensures quality audio on every journey. The in-vehicle trailering system app and hitch guidance with hitch view take the complexity out of towing.

The X31 Off-Road Package equips this truck with the tools for rugged work environments. The 2-speed active transfer case, hill descent control, and off-road suspension provide the dynamic capability to handle uneven terrain and challenging conditions, while rain-sensing wipers and auto high-beam headlights adapt to whatever weather you encounter.

This 2025 Sierra 2500HD AT4 represents serious capability built for serious work. We invite you to experience it firsthand and discover why this truck delivers the performance and presence your work demands.

The 2025 Ram 2500 Laramie represents a serious investment in capability and comfort for those who demand performance from their work truck and daily driver alike.

- 6.7L I6 engine with 8-speed automatic transmission and 4WD
- Laramie Level 2 Plus Equipment Group with premium amenities
- Night Edition package featuring 20-inch black painted aluminum wheels and sport performance hood
- 17-speaker Harman/Kardon premium sound system with SiriusXM connectivity
- 14.4-inch Uconnect 5 navigation touchscreen with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Power deployable running boards and MOPAR spray-in bedliner
- Heated and ventilated leather-trimmed bucket seats with power adjustment
- Adaptive steering system with active lane management
- Remote tailgate release and center stop lamp with cargo view camera
- Auto high beam headlamp control and rain-sensitive windshield wipers
- Dual wireless charging pads and heated steering wheel
- MOPAR front and rear rubber floor mats with transfer case skid plate shield
- Drowsy driver detection and traffic sign recognition
- Power heated fold telescoping mirrors with memory settings
- Full suite of safety features including electronic stability control and multiple airbags

This truck arrives finished in Gray with all the technical sophistication you'd expect from Ram's Laramie tier. The Night Edition package adds aggressive styling with its black-painted 20-inch wheels, gloss black grille elements, and sport performance hood, giving this 2500 a commanding presence on the road or at the job site. The comprehensive comfort package includes leather-trimmed bucket seats that adjust eight ways with lumbar support, dual-zone automatic climate control, and a full-length floor console with wireless charging capability.

The Uconnect 5 system keeps you connected with navigation, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, and integrated voice command via Bluetooth. Your music choices expand with the 17-speaker Harman/Kardon audio setup and SiriusXM with 360L capability. The MOPAR spray-in bedliner and deployable bed step make loading and unloading practical, while LED bed lighting illuminates your work area.

Standard on this Laramie is the anti-spin differential rear axle for improved traction, power deployable running boards for easier entry and exit, and an array of convenience features like power-adjustable pedals with memory, remote tailgate release, and auto-dimming exterior mirrors. Safety systems including drowsy driver detection, traffic sign recognition, and active lane management work continuously to support your driving.

The combination of the 6.7L I6 diesel engine with 4WD and the Night Edition styling presents a truck ready for both demanding work and weekend adventures. With just over 5,600 miles on the odometer, this 2025 model is virtually new and ready for its next owner.

We invite you to experience this truck in our showroom and speak with our sales team about what makes it the right choice for your needs.

This White exterior with its 6.7L I6 engine and 8-Speed Automatic transmission delivers the performance and reliability you need, backed by a Clean Carfax and single-owner history that speaks to how well this truck has been maintained. - Power Heated Fold Telescope Mirrors w/Memory - Leather Trimmed Bucket Seats with Ventilated Front Seats - Uconnect 5 Navigation System with 12.0' Touchscreen - Active Lane Management System - MOPAR Spray In Bedliner - LED Bed Lighting - Dual Wireless Charging Pad - Adaptive Steering System - Traffic Sign Recognition - Auto High Beam Headlight Control - Remote Tailgate Release - MOPAR Deployable Bed Step - Drowsy Driver Detection - Rain Sensitive Windshield Wipers - SiriusXM 360L with 4G LTE Wi-Fi Hotspot The Laramie Level 1 Plus Equipment Group and Night Edition package elevate this truck with premium features you'll appreciate every time you get behind the wheel. The black painted 20-inch aluminum wheels paired with gloss black grille accents and sport performance hood create a commanding presence. Inside, power adjustable pedals with memory, heated steering wheel, and a full-length upgraded floor console ensure every trip feels tailored to you. Technology integrates seamlessly throughout this truck. The Uconnect 5 navigation system keeps you on course, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity keep you linked to your world. Heated front seats with lumbar adjustment and cooling vents provide comfort in any season, and the center stop lamp with cargo view camera adds practical convenience for bed management. Safety features are comprehensive and thoughtful. You'll find electronic stability control, traction control, dual front impact airbags, brake assist, and an emergency vehicle alert system working together to protect you. The adaptive steering system responds to road conditions, while active lane management helps you stay centered on the highway. The 4WD system with anti-spin differential rear axle and 3.42 axle ratio gives you confident traction whether you're on-road or off. The 5th wheel and gooseneck towing prep group means this truck is ready when you are. With LED bed lighting and a spray-in bedliner, your workspace is both functional and protected. This 2025 Ram 2500 Laramie combines truck toughness with genuine refinement. We invite you to experience it firsthand at our showroom, where our team is ready to discuss how this truck fits your needs and to answer any questions you may have about ownership.

The heated and ventilated front seats adjust in 12 ways with lumbar support, while rear outboard passengers enjoy heated seating as well. Climate control is automatic and zoned for the front, ensuring everyone stays comfortable.

The advanced infotainment system supports both Apple CarPlay and Android Auto for smartphone integration, while satellite radio connectivity keeps you entertained during long hauls. The multicolor head-up display keeps critical information in your line of sight, and the surround vision system with multiple cameras makes parking and maneuvering easier. Wireless charging for your devices and multiple USB ports throughout the cabin keep you connected.

Safety features are comprehensive and designed to protect you and your passengers. Automatic emergency braking, forward collision alert, lane departure warning, and blind spot monitoring work together to provide confidence on the road. The trailer side blind zone alert and hitch guidance with hitch view take the stress out of towing operations.

This truck is equipped to work or play, with the luxury to make every mile enjoyable. The white frost tricoat exterior gleams in any light, while the signature chrome Denali grille and polished exhaust tip announce your presence with authority. Premium floor liners protect the cabin, and the spray-on bedliner with GMC logo guards the cargo area.

This 2025 GMC Sierra 2500HD Denali represents serious capability and refined comfort in a full-size truck platform. Finished in White Frost Tricoat with the Denali Reserve Package, this truck combines purposeful engineering with premium appointments designed for those who demand both performance and sophistication.

- Duramax 6.6L V8 Turbodiesel engine with 470 horsepower and 975 lb-ft of torque
- MAX TRAILERING PACKAGE with upgraded frame, leaf springs, 12" rear axle, and gooseneck/5th wheel prep
- Power-retractable assist steps with LED perimeter lighting
- Multicolor 15" diagonal head-up display with truck information
- Premium Bose 7-speaker sound system with SiriusXM satellite radio
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto smartphone integration
- Heated and ventilated front seats with 12-way power adjustment and lumbar support
- Forge perforated leather-appointed front bucket seats
- Power sunroof included with Denali Reserve Package
- Advanced safety suite including automatic emergency braking and lane departure warning
- HD surround vision camera system with hitch guidance and trailer view
- Spray-on pickup bedliner with GMC logo
- Signature chrome Denali grille with premium styling throughout
- Bed view camera with trailer camera provisions

The Sierra 2500HD Denali equips you with practical technology for towing and hauling while maintaining the comfort level expected in a luxury truck. The Duramax turbodiesel engine delivers strong torque characteristics, while the MAX TRAILERING PACKAGE ensures your truck is engineered for heavy-duty work. The upfitter switch kit with configurable circuits opens possibilities for custom electrical accessories tailored to your specific needs.

Inside, the Denali Reserve Package delivers genuine wood accents on the dashboard and door panels, creating an upscale cabin environment. The heated steering wheel, wireless charging pad, and premium sound system make every drive more enjoyable. Multiple USB charging ports and power outlets throughout the cabin keep your devices powered and ready. The automatic high-beam headlights and rain-sensing wipers handle changing conditions without requiring your attention.

Safety systems are comprehensive and modern. Automatic emergency braking works alongside forward pedestrian braking and rear cross-traffic alert to help protect you in various driving situations. The ultrasonic front and rear park assist simplifies maneuvering in tight spaces, while the trailer side blind zone alert adds confidence when towing. The surround vision camera system provides a complete view around the truck, and the inside rearview auto-dimming camera mirror enhances visibility during reverse operations.

The X31 off-road package and 2-speed active transfer case deliver capability beyond standard highway use. Hill descent control helps manage steep grades safely, while the off-road suspension and all-terrain engineering address uneven terrain. The 220-amp alternator and engine block heater support both heavy electrical loads and cold-weather reliability.

Visit McGee Chevrolet of Middlebury to experience the 2025 Sierra 2500HD Denali firsthand. Our team is ready to discuss customization options through our on-site parts and accessory department, and we'll ensure you understand every feature designed to serve your work and lifestyle needs.

This 2021 Ford F-150 Lariat Shelby Super Snake SuperCrew is equipped with 775HP and a lift kit that raises the truck's stance, along with BFGoodrich 35x12.50R22 Nitto Ridge Grappler tires that fill the wheel openings and suit the truck's modified road presence. It carries the Lariat Sport Appearance Package, Angular Running Boards, and Front License Plate Bracket, while the exterior proportions are defined by the 5.5 ft. short bed and the added height from the suspension work. The truck also includes a Power Tailgate, which adds a convenient touch to the rear of the bed without changing the F-150's basic utility.

Inside, this F-150 uses Leather-Trimmed Bucket Seats with a flow-through console, paired with Leather Seats and a cabin finished to Lariat trim expectations. The Equipment Group 502A brings a full set of comfort and convenience equipment, including the Panoramic Sunroof and Twin Panel Panoramic Moonroof, which extend daylight across the front and rear seating areas. A 110V/400W Outlet is built into the cabin, and an Engine Block Heater is included among the factory options. The overall interior presentation is straightforward and focused on daily use, with materials and controls arranged in the familiar Ford manner.

Technology and driver assistance equipment are well represented, with Ford Co-Pilot360 Assist 2.0, Adaptive Cruise Control, Lane Keep Assist, and a 360 Degree Camera included on this truck. The B&O Sound System Unleashed by Bang & Olufsen with HD Radio supplies the Premium Audio feature set, and Wi-Fi Hotspot capability is also present for in-vehicle connectivity. The instrumented driving aids and camera coverage are joined by the Integrated Trailer Brake Controller, which ties in with the Trailer Tow Package for towing-related use. These items are part of the truck's original equipment and are integrated into the cabin and control systems rather than added as separate accessories.

Mechanical and towing-related details round out the build, including the 3.73 Electronic Locking Axle Ratio and the Extended Range 36 Gallon Fuel Tank. This Ram 1500 TRX combines serious truck capability with luxury truck refinement. Performance and presence arrive together in this 2023 Ram 1500 TRX. The combination of engineering excellence and premium appointments makes this truck a definitive choice for discerning buyers who refuse to compromise on power, luxury, or capability.

The Heads-Up Display projects vital information directly into your line of sight, and the Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium System with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration keeps you connected seamlessly.

Automatic Emergency Braking, Rear Cross Traffic Braking, Lane Keep Assist, and the Safety Alert Seat form a comprehensive protective net. The HD Surround Vision system provides 360-degree awareness, while the Rear Camera Mirror and multiple view angles eliminate blind spots entirely.

This truck stands ready for whatever demands you place on it—whether that's serious towing with the integrated trailer brake controller and hitch guidance system, commanding presence with its aggressive stance and tubular assist steps, or simply the confidence that comes from owning a machine built to handle anything. The Preferred Equipment Group 3LT, Technology Package, and Up-Level Rear Seat with Storage Package represent a fully-loaded investment in capability and comfort.

We invite you to visit and experience this exceptional Silverado firsthand. This is a truck that earns its place in your driveway.

The Predator drop step and rear step bumper make bed access easier, while the tri-fold tonneau cover secures your cargo and protects it from weather. The 120V deck and cabin power supply lets you charge tools and equipment on the job site. The ball mount is included for towing applications. Nightshade Package styling, including distinctive exterior trim and matte black 20-inch alloy wheels, gives this Tundra a commanding presence.We invite you to visit our showroom to see this 2026 Tundra Limited in person and schedule a test drive that will demonstrate its capabilities and comfort firsthand.

This 2022 GMC Sierra 2500HD Denali delivers the capability and sophistication you need for work, adventure, and daily driving with unwavering confidence.

- Duramax 6.6L V8 Turbodiesel engine with 445 hp and 910 lb-ft of torque
- Suncoast Stage 6 Transmission with full billet torque converter for enhanced performance
- New 37-inch tires paired with heavy-duty suspension and off-road capability
- Upper Cognito control arms for improved handling and durability
- Gooseneck/5th wheel prep package with hitch platform and bed-mounted harness
- Power-retractable assist steps with LED perimeter lighting
- Heated and ventilated front bucket seats with 10-way power adjusters and lumbar support
- Premium GMC Infotainment System with navigation and SiriusXM 360L
- Wireless phone projection and Apple CarPlay/Android Auto compatibility
- HD Surround Vision with trailer view camera provisions
- Integrated trailer brake controller with hitch guidance
- Lane departure warning and rear cross traffic alert
- Spray-on pickup box bed liner with Denali logo
- Power sunroof and universal home remote
- 220-amp alternator and engine block heater

This truck has been enhanced with over $20,000 in quality upgrades, including a premium transmission package and professional-grade tires designed for serious hauling and towing. The Denali trim elevates the driving experience with refined interior appointments, including forge perforated leather-appointed seating and genuine wood accents. The white exterior presents a clean, professional appearance that commands attention on any job site or road.

The advanced trailering technology makes managing heavy loads intuitive and secure. The trailer tire pressure monitoring system, integrated brake controller, and hitch guidance with hitch view camera put you in complete control. Whether you're preparing for a fifth-wheel setup or managing daily towing responsibilities, this truck is engineered to handle the demands.

Modern safety features work behind the scenes to protect you and your passengers. Automatic emergency braking, forward collision alert, lane change alert with side blind zone detection, and a comprehensive airbag system provide multiple layers of protection. The off-road suspension and 4-wheel independent front suspension deliver stability across varying terrain.

Inside, connectivity and comfort take priority. The premium Bose audio system delivers exceptional sound quality, while wireless charging keeps your devices powered throughout the day. Dual-zone climate control, heated steering wheel, and remote vehicle starter ensure your comfort in any season.

This Sierra 2500HD Denali represents a significant investment in capability and quality. Visit our showroom to experience the commanding presence and commanding performance of this fully equipped diesel truck.

This 2022 Ford F-250SD Platinum in Black delivers the capability and refinement you expect from a heavy-duty truck engineered for serious work and premium comfort.

- FX4 Off-Road Package with Hill Descent Control and off-road tuned suspension
- Power Stroke 6.7L V8 Diesel Turbocharged engine with manual exhaust braking
- Twin Panel Power Moonroof for enhanced cabin brightness and ventilation
- SYNC 4 with Enhanced Voice Recognition and Connected Navigation
- B&O Sound System by Bang & Olufsen with SiriusXM 360L
- Dual front and side impact airbags with overhead airbag protection
- Electronic-locking differential with 3.31 axle ratio
- Front and rear wheel well liners pre-installed
- Exterior parking camera and rear parking sensors
- Engine block heater for reliable cold-weather starting
- Six upfitter switches for custom accessory integration
- Heated power door mirrors with turn signal indicators
- Leather steering wheel with mounted audio controls
- Automatic high-beam headlights with fog lights
- Auto-dimming rear-view mirror with compass

The diesel engine combines proven Power Stroke technology with a 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD capability, delivering the torque and pulling power you need for demanding applications. The 34-gallon fuel tank and 240-amp alternator support extended service intervals and continuous accessory operation. With dual 78-AH batteries, this truck starts reliably in any season.

The Platinum trim elevates your driving experience with a B&O premium audio system, dual-zone automatic climate control, and a spacious cabin designed for comfort during long hours behind the wheel. Front bucket seats with power adjustments, a center console armrest, and split-folding rear seating provide flexibility for passengers and cargo. The electronically controlled rear window defroster and heated mirrors ensure clear visibility in winter conditions.

Off-road capability comes standard with the FX4 package, featuring hill descent control, off-road specifically tuned shock absorbers, and transfer case and fuel tank skid plates for protection during challenging terrain. The electronic-locking differential with 3.31 axle ratio maximizes traction when you need it most. The 10,000-pound GVWR payload package supports substantial hauling capacity for work or recreation.

Technology and connectivity define modern truck ownership. SYNC 4 puts voice control, emergency assistance, and navigation at your fingertips, while SiriusXM 360L streaming keeps you entertained across the country. Parking sensors and a rear camera make maneuvering easier, and the six upfitter switches enable seamless integration of aftermarket accessories like winches, bed equipment, or service bodies.

This F-250SD Platinum combines diesel efficiency with the robust construction built for years of reliable service. Contact our sales team to schedule a test drive and discover how this truck meets your needs.

description:
This 2022 Ford F-250SD Lariat in white combines professional capability with refined comfort, delivering a truck built for serious work and quality living.

- Power Stroke 6.7L V8 Diesel Turbocharged engine with 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD
- Lariat Ultimate Package with power heated and ventilated driver and passenger seats featuring memory
- PowerScope Trailer Tow Mirrors with memory and heat
- 5th Wheel/Gooseneck Hitch Prep Package with integrated 7-pin connector
- Camper Package with heavy-service front springs and rear auxiliary springs
- Intelligent Access with push-button start and remote tailgate release
- SYNC 4 with enhanced voice recognition and connected navigation
- B&O Sound System by Bang & Olufsen with SiriusXM 360L
- LED box lighting and roof clearance lights
- Power-deployable running boards and tailgate step and handle
- Memory power-adjustable pedals and power telescoping steering wheel
- Electronic-locking differential with 3.31 axle ratio
- 18-inch bright machined cast aluminum wheels with all-terrain tires
- Dual front zone automatic climate control with rear window defroster
- Remote start system and ambient lighting

The F-250SD Lariat represents Ford's dedication to driver satisfaction. This truck arrives equipped with the diesel engine that has earned its reputation for durability and efficiency in demanding work environments. The 4WD system provides the traction needed for challenging terrain, while the electronic-locking differential enhances capability when traction matters most.

Inside the cab, the Lariat Ultimate Package transforms the driving experience with features designed for long hours and extended journeys. Power-heated and ventilated seats with memory settings adapt to your preferences automatically. The memory power-adjustable pedals and telescoping steering wheel ensure consistent comfort for every driver. SYNC 4 technology keeps you connected with voice recognition that understands natural speech, while the B&O sound system delivers quality audio for your daily commute or long hauls.

This truck takes hauling seriously. The 5th Wheel/Gooseneck Hitch Prep Package includes five pickup bed attachment points and an integrated connector, ready for your towing setup. The Camper Package adds heavy-service front springs and rear auxiliary springs, preparing the truck for the additional loads that specialty equipment demands. PowerScope Trailer Tow Mirrors with memory keep visibility clear and adjust automatically based on stored preferences.

LED box lighting illuminates the bed, while roof clearance lights enhance visibility. Meet the 2022 Chevrolet Silverado 3500HD High Country in stunning Cherry Red Tintcoat—a truck built for those who demand capability without compromise. This powerful diesel-powered pickup combines premium features with genuine utility, offering the foundation for work, adventure, or everyday reliability.

- Duramax 6.6L V8 Turbodiesel engine with 445 hp and 910 lb-ft of torque
- 4WD with Z71 Off-Road Package including Rancho shocks and Hill Descent Control
- High Country Deluxe trim with premium leather seating and heated seats
- Power Sunroof on Crew Cab model
- Multi-Flex Tailgate with six functional load/access features
- Power-Retractable Assist Steps with LED lighting
- Hard-Folding Tonneau Cover for bed security and weather protection
- Advanced safety suite with lane departure warning, blind spot monitor, and rear cross traffic alert
- Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Bose Premium 7-Speaker Sound System with SiriusXM and 360L
- All-Weather Floor Liners protecting interior investment
- Integrated Trailer Brake Controller and Gooseneck/5th Wheel Prep Package
- Remote Vehicle Starter System and wireless phone projection
- 20-inch polished aluminum wheels with all-terrain capability

The High Country trim elevates the ownership experience with premium amenities designed for serious truck drivers who appreciate refinement. Perforated leather seating surfaces pair with ventilated front seats and heated steering wheel, creating comfort during long hours behind the wheel. The Bose audio system and Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium keep you connected with navigation, smartphone integration, and satellite radio entertainment throughout your journey.

This Silverado 3500HD's work ethic matches its polished appearance. The Duramax turbodiesel delivers the torque and power needed for towing and hauling, while the integrated trailer brake controller and advanced trailering system handle those responsibilities with precision. The Z71 Off-Road Package equips the truck with genuine terrain capability through off-road tuned Rancho shocks, Hill Descent Control, and protective skid plates on the transfer case and oil pan. When duty calls, this truck answers.

Technology integrates seamlessly throughout the cabin. The multicolor 15-inch head-up display keeps critical information visible, while the bed view camera with trailer camera provisions provides visibility during backing and hitching operations. Automatic emergency braking, forward collision alert, and the safety alert seat work continuously to help protect occupants. The 8-inch driver information center lets you monitor engine performance and vehicle diagnostics at a glance.

Condition tells the story of a well-maintained truck. With just over 24,000 miles, this one-owner, non-smoker vehicle has been carefully preserved and is freshly detailed. The cherry red finish gleams with depth and presence, while the chrome accents and polished aluminum wheels reflect genuine pride of ownership. All-weather floor liners protected the cabin during daily use, and the hard-folding tonneau cover has safeguarded the Durabed throughout ownership.

This 2022 Silverado 3500HD High Country represents exceptional value for anyone seeking a premium heavy-duty truck equipped to handle real work alongside genuine luxury. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this diesel powerhouse firsthand.

description:
This 2022 Ford F-250SD Lariat combines capability with refined comfort, offering a truck built for both work and the road ahead.

- Tough Bed Spray-In Bedliner
- Tremor Off-Road Package with electronic locking differentials and rock crawl mode
- Black Appearance Package with 20" High-Gloss Black wheels and ebony black accents
- Twin Panel Power Moonroof
- Power Heated/Ventilated Driver and Passenger Seats with Memory
- PowerScope Trailer Tow Mirrors with Memory and Heat
- Lane Departure Warning System
- Connected Navigation system
- B&O Sound System by Bang & Olufsen with SiriusXM 360L
- SYNC 4 with Enhanced Voice Recognition
- Remote Start System
- LED Box Lighting
- Easy Entry/Exit Memory Driver's Seat Feature
- Memory Power-Adjustable Pedals
- Universal Garage Door Opener

Finished in white exterior paint, this F-250SD presents a clean, professional appearance enhanced by the Black Appearance Package. The ebony black fender vents, grille bars, and mirror caps create striking contrast, while the 6" ebony black angular running boards and body-color bumpers add purposeful style. Black out surrounds frame the LED-only headlamps, and pre-installed rear wheel well liners provide protection.

The Tremor Off-Road Package elevates capability with a rear electronic locking differential, front limited slip differential, and performance-tuned front and rear shock absorbers. Unique front air dams improve approach angle, while transfer case and fuel tank skid plates offer underbody protection. Rock crawl mode and trail control mode deliver precise handling on challenging terrain. The package includes all-terrain tires suited for both on and off-road performance.

Powered by a 7.3L V8 engine with 385 horsepower and a 10-speed automatic transmission, this truck delivers robust performance. Four-wheel drive provides confident traction in varied conditions, while the electronic locking 4.30 axle ratio contributes to capability and control.

This vehicle is certified, which reflects our commitment to quality and your peace of mind. Every certified vehicle undergoes rigorous inspection to ensure it meets exacting standards for performance, safety, and condition.

Inside, the Lariat Value Package provides comfort and convenience features including power heated and ventilated seats with memory settings, memory power-adjustable pedals, and an easy entry/exit memory driver's seat. The leather-wrapped steering wheel, flow-through console, and ambient lighting create an inviting cabin environment. SYNC 4 with enhanced voice recognition provides intuitive control, while the B&O Sound System and SiriusXM 360L deliver premium audio entertainment.

The comprehensive safety suite includes automatic high-beam headlights, electronic stability control, traction control, dual front and side airbags, and rear parking sensors with an exterior parking camera. Brake assist and ABS brakes enhance stopping control, while the 4-wheel disc brake system provides reliable performance.

We invite you to experience this capable, well-equipped F-250SD in our showroom. Contact us today to schedule your test drive and discover why this truck is the right choice for your needs.

This 2022 Ram 2500 Laramie in white delivers the capability and refinement you need for demanding work and premium driving comfort. With the legendary Cummins 6.7L I6 turbodiesel engine and 4WD, this truck is built to handle serious tasks while offering the technology and luxury appointments of the Laramie trim.

- Cummins 6.7L I6 Turbodiesel with 6-Speed Automatic
- Uconnect 5 Navigation with 12.0" touchscreen display and GPS
- 17-Speaker Harman Kardon premium sound system
- Black leather trimmed bucket seats with heated second row
- Auto level rear air suspension for smooth hauling
- Power deployable running boards
- 20" black painted aluminum wheels with all-terrain tires
- Blind spot and cross path detection
- Mirror-mounted auxiliary reverse lamps with power tow mirrors
- Remote tailgate release
- Power adjustable pedals with memory
- Alexa Built-In integration
- SiriusXM connected travel and traffic services
- MOPAR spray-in bedliner
- Black Night Edition styling with gloss black grille and tailgate badge

The Night Edition package transforms the exterior with aggressive black accents, including black headlamp bezels, painted bumpers, and body-color grille surround. The 20-inch black aluminum wheels wrapped in LT285/60R20E on/off-road tires provide both capability and distinctive presence on the road. Tow hooks, power deployable running boards, and the fifth wheel/gooseneck towing prep group ensure you're equipped for any trailer configuration.

Inside, the premium leather bucket seats with full-length console offer commanding driver positioning and comfort for long drives. The heated second row seats accommodate your crew in style. Radio and driver seat memory functions, along with power-adjustable pedals with memory, personalize your driving experience instantly. The heated steering wheel and dual-zone automatic climate control keep you comfortable in any weather.

The Uconnect 5 navigation system with the 12.0" touchscreen display integrates Apple CarPlay and Android Auto for seamless smartphone connectivity. Built-in Alexa enables voice command functionality, while SiriusXM satellite radio with 360L access keeps you entertained. The cabin features the 17-speaker Harman Kardon system, delivering rich audio clarity throughout the drive.

Safety and visibility are prioritized with blind spot and cross path detection, auto high beam headlamp control, rain-sensitive wipers, and the ParkView rear backup camera. The anti-spin differential rear axle, 220-amp alternator, and heavy-duty engine cooling provide reliable performance in demanding conditions.

Visit us to experience the 2022 Ram 2500 Laramie and discover how this truck combines professional capability with premium comfort and advanced technology.

description:
This 2022 Chevrolet Silverado 3500HD High Country in blue is a premium heavy-duty truck built for those who demand capability, comfort, and commanding presence on the road.

- Duramax 6.6L V8 Turbodiesel engine with 445 hp and 910 lb-ft of torque
- 10-Speed Automatic transmission with 4WD
- Z71 Off-Road Package with off-road tuned Rancho shocks and hill descent control
- Advanced Trailering System with integrated trailer brake controller
- Gooseneck/5th Wheel Prep Package for serious towing applications
- Trailer Tire Pressure Monitor Sensors
- Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Power sunroof on crew cab
- Multicolor 15" Head-Up Display
- HD Surround Vision with trailer view camera provisions
- Heated and ventilated leather front seats with 10-way power adjustment
- Wireless charging and Wi-Fi hotspot capability
- Dual alternators (220-amp primary, 170-amp auxiliary)
- Engine block heater for reliable cold-weather starts

The High Country trim elevates your experience with premium materials and thoughtful amenities. Perforated leather seating surfaces, a heated steering wheel, and automatic climate control create an upscale cab environment. The power sunroof floods the interior with natural light, while the comprehensive technology suite keeps you connected and informed on every drive.

Capability defines this truck. The Duramax diesel engine delivers exceptional torque for hauling and towing, while the integrated advanced trailering system provides precise control. The Z71 suspension package with hill descent control ensures confident performance on challenging terrain, and skid plates protect critical components. Dual alternators provide the electrical power needed for demanding work.

Safety and visibility are paramount. Automatic emergency braking, lane departure warning, and rear cross traffic alert provide active protection. The bed view camera and multiple trailer camera provisions give you complete situational awareness, essential when maneuvering a loaded trailer or backing into tight spots.

Practical features enhance everyday functionality. The auxiliary power outlets, bed-mounted 120-volt outlet, spray-on bedliner with Chevrolet logo, and all-weather floor liners demonstrate attention to the details that matter. LED cargo area lighting illuminates your workspace, while the power sliding rear window with defogger improves ventilation and visibility.

This Silverado 3500HD High Country represents the intersection of work-ready capability and refined comfort. Come experience the confidence that comes with owning a truck engineered for serious duty and premium everyday driving.

Chevrolet positioned this model in its work-focused heavy-duty lineup, and the 3500HD designation identifies it as the larger-capacity version in the Silverado series. The truck's basic structure is aimed at towing, hauling, and day-to-day use in conditions where a lighter-duty pickup may not be the preferred choice. Its proportions reflect that role, with a tall stance and substantial bodywork that support its intended work. The truck also has a backup camera, which adds a rear view display for low-speed maneuvering and parking. The leather upholstery is matched to the rest of the interior in a way that is consistent with a higher-content trim level, while still keeping the focus on durable, everyday use. Durability and practicality merit equal attention. The MOPAR spray-in bedliner protects against corrosion and impacts, while the MOPAR deployable bed step eases access to cargo. LED bed lighting illuminates the work area, and a remote tailgate release adds convenience. The transfer case skid plate shield and front bumper sight shields protect critical components during off-road use or challenging job sites.

This Ram 2500 Laramie offers the complete package—diesel performance, comprehensive technology, genuine comfort, and distinctive styling—ready to work hard and ride smoothly whenever you need it. We invite you to experience the difference in person and discover why this truck represents the premium heavy-duty standard.

Powered by **470 horsepower and an earth-moving 975 lb-ft of torque**, this Duramax is engineered to tackle virtually anything you can hook behind it. Inside you'll find a massive **13.4-inch HD touchscreen** with built-in Google integration, wireless Apple CarPlay® and Android Auto™, remote start, push-button start, heated **and ventilated** front seats, a heated steering wheel, dual-zone automatic climate control, a head-up display, digital rear camera mirror, power sunroof, heated towing mirrors, an EZ Lift power lock-and-release tailgate, spray-in bedliner, a **120-volt outlet in both the cabin and cargo bed**, and enough technology to make your daily commute just as enjoyable as a weekend towing the toys.

Here's the reality: trucks like this don't sit around. Whether you're towing every day, managing a fleet, hauling equipment, or simply want one of the nicest heavy-duty pickups money can buy, this Silverado delivers in every category.

Shopping from another state? **We'll gladly help you.** Shopping from across the country? **Absolutely.** Even if you're on the other side of the world, **your money spends just fine here.** And if you're local... what are you still doing reading this?** Come test drive this beast before someone else beats you to it.**

This 2025 GMC Sierra 1500 Denali Ultimate delivers premium capability and refined comfort for buyers who demand both performance and luxury in their truck.

- Bose Premium Series with 12-Speaker System
- Heads-Up Display with 15" diagonal multicolor screen

- Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity
- Ventilated front seats with 16-way power adjustment and lumbar support

- Hitch Guidance and integrated trailer brake controller

The truck's exterior speaks confidence with its high gloss black header and signature Denali grille, complemented by LED cargo area lighting and perimeter lighting that enhances visibility. The spray-on pickup bedliner with GMC logo protects your investment, while the 22" ultra-bright machined wheels command attention on any road.

This Sierra 1500 Denali Ultimate with 11,048 miles represents an opportunity to own refined capability. We invite you to experience the commanding presence, sophisticated interior, and purposeful engineering that define this truck.

Safety systems work proactively to protect you and your passengers. Enhanced automatic emergency braking, front pedestrian braking, and rear pedestrian detection provide multiple layers of protection. The safety alert seat, following distance indicator, and ultrasonic front and rear park assist help you navigate confidently in any situation.

This F-150 Lariat represents a balanced investment in capability, comfort, and premium appointments. Contact us today to schedule your test drive and experience the complete package this truck delivers.

This 2025 Ram 1500 RHO in striking Red combines premium capability with thoughtful refinement, delivering a truck that performs as confidently on the road as it does at work.

- RHO Level 1 Equipment Group with premium features
- Uconnect 5 Navigation with 14.4" touchscreen display
- Hands-Free Active Driving Assist System
- Surround View Camera System with ParkView rear backup camera
- harman/kardon 19-speaker premium sound system

- Heated and ventilated front seats with driver seat memory
- Heated second row seats
- Power tailgate with deployable bed step
- Head-up display with traffic sign recognition

This single-owner Ram has been meticulously maintained and has passed a comprehensive 120-point Maryland State Inspection. With accident-free history and low mileage of just 7,617 miles, you're getting a truck that's practically new with the peace of mind of remaining factory warranty coverage.

Premium touches throughout the cabin set this RHO apart—from the real carbon fiber interior accents and leather-wrapped steering wheel to the full-length upgraded floor console. Power adjustable pedals with memory, along with the integrated driver memory settings, let you customize your driving position precisely.

Technology is seamlessly integrated with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, 4G LTE Wi-Fi hotspot capability, and the intuitive Uconnect 5 system. Safety features including evasive steer assist, intersection collision assist, drowsy driver detection, and intelligent adaptive suspension give you confidence in any driving condition.

The truck bed comes equipped with practical MOPAR accessories including a spray-in bedliner, adjustable cargo tie-down hooks, and a deployable bed step for convenient access. The power tailgate and exterior 115V AC outlet add functional convenience for both work and weekend projects.

This Ram 1500 RHO represents thoughtful truck ownership—delivering premium comfort, advanced technology, and genuine capability in one commanding package. We invite you to experience it firsthand at our showroom.

The power-sliding rear window and interior work surface add convenience to your daily operations.

Towing capability is enhanced through the comprehensive Trailer Tow Package, which includes an Integrated Trailer Brake Controller, Pro Trailer Backup Assist, and Pro Trailer Hitch Assist. For those cold mornings, the engine block heater ensures reliable starts and quicker warmups. The twin panel moonroof provides an open-air feel when you want it, and partitioned lockable fold-flat storage keeps your valuables secure.

This F-150 Tremor is ready for work and ready for you. Contact us today to schedule a test drive and see how this truck can serve your needs.

description:
The 2023 GMC Sierra 1500 AT4X represents a refined approach to off-road capability combined with premium comfort and advanced technology. This black beauty delivers the performance and sophistication you expect from GMC's flagship truck lineup.

- Off-Road High Clearance Steps
- EcoTec3 6.2L V8 Engine with 10-Speed Automatic
- 4-Wheel Drive with Driver-Selectable Full-Locking Differentials
- Off-Road Suspension with Hill Descent Control
- Multicolor 15" Diagonal Head-Up Display
- GMC Infotainment System with Navigation
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- SiriusXM 360L Satellite Radio
- Bose Premium Audio System with 12 Speakers
- Full Grain Leather Seat Trim
- Heated and Ventilated Front Seats
- Heated Rear Seats
- Power Moonroof
- 18" Gloss Black Painted Aluminum Wheels
- Spray-On Pickup Bed Liner with AT4X Logo

The Sierra 1500 AT4X is engineered to handle demanding terrain. The driver-selectable full-locking front and rear differentials give you control when tackling challenging landscapes, while the off-road suspension and hill descent control enhance stability on steep grades. The off-road high clearance steps provide convenient access to the elevated cabin.

Inside, this truck prioritizes your comfort during every drive. Premium full grain leather seats with 16-way power adjustments and lumbar support keep you properly positioned for long hours behind the wheel. The heated and ventilated front seats adjust to seasonal preferences, while heated rear seats ensure passenger comfort year-round. A power moonroof floods the cabin with natural light, creating an open and inviting atmosphere.

Technology seamlessly integrates throughout the cabin. The multicolor head-up display projects essential information directly into your line of sight, reducing distractions. The premium GMC infotainment system supports navigation, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, and SiriusXM 360L satellite radio. Multiple USB ports, wireless charging, and Wi-Fi hotspot capability keep your devices connected. Advanced safety features include automatic emergency braking, lane keep assist with lane departure warning, and surround vision cameras that provide comprehensive awareness around the truck.

The exterior showcases purpose-built design. Onyx black paint creates a commanding presence, while the gloss black header with dark nickel grille insert bars reflect premium aesthetics. LED cargo area lighting, heated power mirrors, and auto-dimming capabilities enhance functionality. The spray-on pickup bed liner protects your cargo space while displaying the AT4X logo with pride. Rainsensing wipers and front fog lights adapt to changing conditions.

This 2023 Sierra 1500 AT4X stands ready to deliver the combination of capable performance, refined comfort, and sophisticated technology you deserve. We invite you to visit our showroom and experience this exceptional truck firsthand.

This 2023 Ford F-250SD Lariat combines professional capability with refined luxury, delivering a truck built for those who demand both performance and comfort on every journey.

- Sport Appearance Package with 20" Dark Carbonized Gray Painted Aluminum wheels and dark grille
- FX4 Off-Road Package with Hill Descent Control and off-road tuned shock absorbers
- Lariat Ultimate Package featuring Ford Co-Pilot 360 2.0 with advanced safety technology
- Power Stroke 6.7L V8 Turbodiesel engine with 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD
- Head-Up Display for essential driving information
- Radio: B&O Unleashed Sound System by Bang & Olofsen with 18 speakers and subwoofer
- Twin Panel Power Moonroof with map lights
- Intelligent Adaptive Cruise Control with Stop-and-Go capability
- Pro Trailer Backup Assist and Pro Trailer Hitch Assist
- Wireless Charging Pad and power-deployable running boards
- Heated and ventilated front leather seats with memory functions
- Connected Navigation system with rear camera and reverse brake assist
- SYNC 4 with Enhanced Voice Recognition and 911 Assist
- Electronic-locking rear differential with 3.31 axle ratio
- Dual 68 AH/65 AGM batteries for reliable starting power

The exterior showcases distinctive styling elements that set this truck apart. The Sport Appearance Package includes body-color front and rear bumpers, matching mirror caps, black tow hooks, and a dark-painted grille that creates a cohesive, premium appearance. Platform running boards and the sport 4x4 box side decal reinforce its purposeful design, while the chrome exhaust tip adds a refined finishing touch.

Under the hood lies the legendary Power Stroke 6.7L V8 Turbodiesel engine paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission. This proven powertrain delivers the dependable performance you expect from a Super Duty, backed by features like manual push-button engine-exhaust braking and an intelligent oil-life monitor. The 34-gallon fuel tank and 250-amp alternator support extended operation, while the operator-commanded regeneration system maintains efficiency.

The FX4 Off-Road Package demonstrates Ford's commitment to versatility. Off-road specifically tuned shock absorbers, transfer case and fuel tank skid plates, and Hill Descent Control prepare this truck for challenging terrain. Whether navigating rough job sites or weekend adventures, the FX4-equipped Super Duty responds with proven capability.

Inside, the Lariat Ultimate Package elevates the ownership experience with premium amenities and cutting-edge safety technology. The B&O Unleashed Sound System delivers exceptional audio clarity through 18 speakers including a dedicated subwoofer. Heated and ventilated leather seats with memory functions, a heated steering wheel, and an auto-dimming rear-view mirror create a refined cabin environment. The Head-Up Display projects critical driving information onto the windshield, keeping your attention where it matters most.

Ford Co-Pilot 360 2.0 provides comprehensive driver assistance with pre-collision assist, automatic emergency braking with pedestrian detection, lane-keeping assist and alert, blind spot information system with cross-traffic alert, and automatic high-beam headlights. The Tow Technology Package includes Pro Trailer Backup Assist and Pro Trailer Hitch Assist, making towing intuitive and manageable. Additionally, six upfitter switches in the overhead console offer flexibility for customization.

This gray F-250SD Lariat represents a balanced choice for buyers seeking a truck that excels in capability, technology, and comfort. We invite you to experience this truck firsthand and discover why it stands as a compelling option in the Super Duty lineup.
